purpose: Manual hosted development qualification only; no release/deployment or physical Mac gate

dispatch.ref: The separately authorized dedicated B3 branch, after parent validation and automatic-deployment checks
dispatch.standalone: .github/workflows/flutter-qualification.yml supports workflow_dispatch and workflow_call; a new file absent the default branch may not be directly dispatchable
dispatch.permission: Parent alone pushes/dispatches after explicit user authorization; this preparation performs neither

toolchain.deployment_target: 15.0: intersection of Flutter upstream macOS12 minimum and MCW native macOS15 requirement
toolchain.installation: Private runner-temp official architecture-matched SDK archive, pinned SHA256 plus official manifest cross-check before execution; Rust via pinned existing rust-toolchain action and exact toolchain version; preinstalled Xcode selected by DEVELOPER_DIR without sudo or global xcode-select

support_findings.intel_host: Flutter3.47 still distributes an x64 macOS SDK and supports Intel development; deprecated, not already removed
support_findings.intel_runtime: Flutter3.47 supported-platform table lists macOS x64 and arm64, macOS12-27; upstream support is not MCW runtime qualification
support_findings.intel_plan: Public strategy proposes reduced Intel CI September2026, host development removal April/May2027 and eventual universal-runtime removal TBD aligned with Xcode. A proposal date is not proof that a stage executed; pinned3.47.8 is not a perpetual support promise
support_findings.maintenance: Revisit Intel strategy before adopting a future Flutter/Xcode version; run both native hosted architectures, never substitute Rosetta-only execution

actions: Require disposable non-root GitHub-hosted macos-15-intel/x86_64 and macos-15/arm64; reject architecture/toolchain drift
Build locked flutter-desktop Rust engine retaining AppKit; build normal release Flutter using official CLI and pub lockfile

Build separate release-sandbox runner with MCW_QUALIFICATION compile flag; hooks absent normal release and only report native window state/perform owned NSWindow close, no mutable endpoint or entitlement
Copy full app preserving framework symlinks into private prefixes beside matching mcw; manifest file hashes, sizes and symlink destinations

Inspect actual bundle identity, official AppIcon presence, minimum OS15, complete Flutter/App frameworks, every Mach-O lipo architecture/build minimum, ACLs, actual codesign identity/entitlements and strict deep seal
Probe existing Aqua/on-console screen and existing Screen Recording authorization without prompting or granting anything
If Aqua absent emit explicit not-executed graphical receipt, never fabricate runtime/IPC/native/menu success
On Aqua run exact release and instrumented bundles through real read-only Rust owner, real collectors and positive-sequence parent-admitted Ready proving sandbox/inherited stdin-stdout IPC

Instrumented window: visible/title/geometry, three native singleton activations preserving one child/key window, normal performClose path with engine exit/no auto-reopen, native activation reopen, parent death while open
Capture only known owned window ID and only existing Screen Recording authorization; otherwise explicit not-executed capture receipt; never capture the desktop or grant TCC

Run existing native_macos_menu.py against unchanged production AppKit/menu/status-item declarations with explicitly simulated data and isolated fixture roots, preserving its actual native captures and provenance
Native fallback checkbox controls strictly decode required preferences.writable and disable all preference actions for qualification false; production true retains behavior, no legacy default/shim
Always upload command exits/stdout/stderr, source/toolchain pins, receipts, window captures if possible, and payload identities for14days; never publish release assets
limitations: All new hosted execution remains unexecuted until authorized push/dispatch completes
No physical capture/control, microphone/camera permission or restoration test
No physical/manual Mac is required or treated as a release blocker
No Developer ID signing, notarization or Gatekeeper acceptance claim from an ad-hoc seal
No app installation/update/uninstall qualification; prefixes are not public installer packages
Whole-process suspension can suspend the native parent monitor; no unconditional kernel-enforced Darwin parent-death guarantee
AppKit remains operational fallback; its simulated visual harness is not real Flutter IPC or hardware evidence
No new entitlements, sandbox removal, Rosetta installation, Accessibility grants or security relaxation
Official icon source PNGs and canonical SVG retained from B2; compiled icon presence and captures are not a new pixel-perfect branding certification
